client.title: Namaste, welcome back
client.sub: Your sessions, tracking and files live here — in English or Hindi, whichever feels like home.

provider.title: Today's list
provider.sub: Appointments, patient notes and earnings for your practice, gathered in one calm place.

admin.title: Organisation overview
admin.sub: Providers, clients, payments and policy in one console. Clinical content stays out of reach here by design.

public.title: Begin your consultation
public.sub: Tell us a little about yourself and we will connect you with a provider or the earliest available slot.

home.title: Care that meets you where you are
home.titleHindi: आपकी भाषा, आपकी गति में देखभाल
home.promise: Book a licensed psychiatrist or psychologist for a video consultation — in English or Hindi, on your schedule.
home.urgentHelp: If you are in immediate danger or crisis, please call a local emergency number or go to your nearest hospital right away.

login.title: Sign in
login.sub: Enter your phone number and we will send a one-time code.
login.otpSub: Dev build: the code is always {code}.
login.errorOtp: That code doesn't match. In this dev build, use {code}.

intake.title: Tell us a little about you
intake.sub: Just three questions — then choose a provider or the earliest available slot.
intake.underageTitle: We're not able to book this online yet
intake.underageBody: Saday's online consultations are for adults (18+). Please ask a parent or guardian to call us at {phone} to book on your behalf.
intake.choiceTitle: How would you like to book, {name}?
intake.choiceProviderSub: Browse psychiatrists and psychologists, see their languages and fees, and pick who feels right.
intake.choiceEarliestSub: We'll match you with whoever has the soonest open slot — usually within a day or two.

providers.title: Choose who you'd like to see
providers.sub: Every provider below has an open slot in the next two weeks.
providers.empty: No providers match these filters right now — try clearing a filter.
providers.earliestOption: Or let us assign the earliest available slot

booking.consentBody: I understand this is an online consultation, not an in-person examination, and I consent to receive care by video/audio call in line with Saday Wellness's telemedicine practice guidelines and privacy policy.
booking.consentRequired: Please accept the telemedicine consent to continue.
booking.assignedSub: Based on earliest availability across all our providers.
booking.noEarliestAvailable: No providers have an open slot in the next two weeks. Please check back soon.
booking.selectSessionTypeFirst: Choose a session type to see available times.

confirmed.title: You're all set, {name}
confirmed.sub: We've reserved your session — see you then.
confirmed.joinPlaceholder: Join link (available 10 minutes before your session)
confirmed.whatsNextBody: You'll get a confirmation on WhatsApp shortly, with a reminder before your session. You can view or manage this booking anytime from Sessions in your account.

appHome.noMoodYet: No mood logs yet — tap "Log mood" to start.

appSessions.title: Sessions
appSessions.sub: Upcoming and past consultations with your care team.
appSessions.noFilesFromSession: No files were shared for this session.
appSessions.cancelPolicyText: Cancellations made at least {hours} hours before the session are refunded in full ({pct}%). Later cancellations may not be refunded.
appSessions.reschedulePolicyText: You can reschedule up to {count} time(s), at least {hours} hours before your session. Your current session will be cancelled once you pick a new time.

appTrack.title: Track
appTrack.sub: Mood, sleep and assessments, all in one place.

appAssessment.meaningBody: This score is a snapshot, not a diagnosis. Your provider will review it alongside how you're doing overall — share anything that feels important at your next session.

appFiles.title: Files
appFiles.sub: Prescriptions, reports and worksheets shared with you.
appFiles.uploadSheetSub: PDF, image, video, audio or Word document, up to 25 MB.
appFiles.uploadTooLarge: That file is larger than 25 MB — please choose a smaller one.
appFiles.uploadBadType: That file type isn't supported. Try a PDF, image, video, audio or Word document.
appFiles.noProviderFiles: Nothing shared by your provider yet.
appFiles.noMaterials: No materials sent to you yet.

appMessages.title: Messages
appMessages.sub: Talk with your care team between sessions.
appMessages.asyncNotice: Your provider replies within 1 working day — this isn't for urgent concerns.
appMessages.empty: No conversations yet — they'll appear here after your first session.

appProfile.title: Profile
appProfile.name: Name
appProfile.phoneNote: Contact us to change your phone number.

switchRole.title: Switch role
switchRole.sub: Sets the saday_dev_role cookie so you can preview the patient, provider and admin shells without real auth. Replaced by Supabase auth in P2.

auth.devSessionNotice: Signed in as a mock {role} session for development. Real Supabase auth replaces this in P2.

today.title: Today
today.unwrittenTileSub: Completed sessions without a signed note
today.availabilityTileSub: Weekly hours, buffers and days off
today.unwrittenSub: Finish these before they go stale

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.sub: Your week in IST. Tap a session for its details and actions.

availability.title: Availability
availability.sub: Weekly hours repeat; days off are exceptions and never touch the grid.

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.sub: One row per paid session. Payouts are marked by Saday admin.
earnings.ledgerEmpty: No paid sessions in this period.
earnings.payoutsNote: Payouts are marked manually by Saday admin (D-018).

more.title: More
more.profileSub: What patients see, session types and prices
more.signOutSub: Dev build: returns to the role switcher

materials.title: Materials library
materials.sub: Browse-only. Send a material from a patient's Files tab so the dispatch is recorded.

profile.title: Profile & settings
profile.sub: These fields appear on your public profile card.
profile.sessionTypesNote: Price and duration changes go through Saday admin in this build.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.sub: Choose what reaches you outside the console.
notifications.note: Delivery channels (WhatsApp, email) are wired in the integration pass (D-025).

providerDetail.languagesSpokenHint: Comma separated, e.g. en, hi, mr
providerDetail.registrationNumberHint: Shown publicly on the provider card (D-030).
providerDetail.commissionHint: Saday's share of each paid session (D-018).
providerDetail.activeHint: Inactive providers are hidden from booking everywhere.
providerDetail.sessionTypesNote: Prices are set here — the provider console shows them read-only.

clients.title: Clients
clients.sub: {count} clients across the organisation. Metadata only — no clinical content is shown here (D-020).

clientDetail.sub: Metadata only — clinical notes, proforma, scores and message content are not shown to admin (D-020/D-029).
clientDetail.messagesNote: {count} message thread(s) with providers. Content is not visible to admin (D-020).
clientDetail.changePhoneNote: Phone is an attribute, not identity (D-031) — confirm the client's identity before migrating their number. The new number will need to be re-verified.

payments.title: Payments
payments.sub: Payments, refunds and payouts for the whole organisation.
payments.payoutsPendingEmpty: No pending payouts — every paid session has been paid out.

followUps.title: Follow-ups
followUps.sub: Org-wide check-in and feedback flows (D-023) — one consistent flow set across every provider.
followUps.hoursCheckInHint: Sent this many hours after the session ends.
followUps.hoursFeedbackHint: Sent this many hours after the check-in.
followUps.hoursInvalid: Enter a whole number of hours, 1–720.
followUps.messageHint: Use placeholders like '{{1}}' and '{{2}}' for WhatsApp template variables (patient name, provider name).
followUps.sendTestSent: Test message written to the dev outbox.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Organisation details, cancellation/reschedule policy and consent version.
settings.policiesNote: Architecture §14 Q4 — placeholder defaults until Saday confirms the real numbers.
settings.templatesNote: Read-only — templates are approved with the BSP (D-015), not edited here.
settings.invalidHours: Enter a positive whole number of hours.
settings.invalidCount: Max reschedules must be 0 or more.
